first_week_creative_rule: All first-week included posts are READY with new branded/text graphic creative. No legacy Financial imagery is used automatically.

post_readiness.creative_brief: Text-led branded graphic showing a simple manuscript-to-book path; no book covers, author photos, excerpts, testimonials, or third-party imagery.
Privacy-safe mission graphic using abstract/community-support shapes or text only; no identifiable people.
Why-first JM1 branded graphic connecting human need to useful work; no division sales claims.
Financial branded text graphic focused on document readiness and trusted decision-makers; no client stories or sensitive facts.
Branded checklist-style text graphic: inquiry, review, fit, next steps. Do not imply acceptance or paid publication guarantee.
Rights-safe branded production-planning graphic using text, storyboard shapes, or original abstract media elements; no client/talent/project imagery.
Financial branded text graphic showing family priorities, documents, insurance considerations, and next steps; no guarantees or client details.
Privacy-safe participation graphic with icons for time, partnership, community, and support; no beneficiary imagery.
Five-brand enterprise map graphic listing J Merrill One, Publishing, Financial, Foundation, and Productions; do not activate Founder Brand.
Calm branded text graphic emphasizing care, clarity, author approval, and quality; no internal workflow jargon.
Financial branded text graphic about pre-need planning as care for family decision-makers; note insurance-product context without claims or guarantees.
Rights-safe branded production-process graphic; no project, client, talent, or copyrighted media assets.
Service/author-journey branded text graphic; intentionally generic because no specific author/title rights evidence is being used.
Impact-oriented text graphic focused on mission and practical support; no statistics or identifiable stories.
